mpower.name: Parkinson Disease Mobile Data Study (mPower)
mpower.label_definition: approx. 3000 (Self-reported PD diagnosis) / unknown / approx. 7000 (Self-reported controls)
mpower.missingness: High longitudinal participant attrition; missing task sessions
mpower.access_requirements: Synapse user registration, human subjects research ethics training, and data access request
mpower.intended_use: Large-scale self-supervised pretraining for mobile digital biomarkers
mpower.main_limitation: Self-reported diagnostic status; variable smartphone sensor quality; high noise

oct500.name: OCT500 Retinal Optical Coherence Tomography Dataset
oct500.missingness: Low SNR frames in deeper choroidal scans
oct500.access_requirements: Academic email registration and non-commercial end-user agreement
oct500.intended_use: Pretraining 3D OCT layer segmentation and retinal nerve fiber layer (RNFL) encoder models
oct500.main_limitation: Contains retinal disease labels (AMD, DR, CNV) but NO Parkinson's disease labels; small sample size (N=500)

physionet_gait.name: Gait in Parkinson's Disease Dataset
physionet_gait.missingness: Minimal frame loss across 2-minute steady walking recordings
physionet_gait.license: Open Data Commons Attribution License (ODC-By) v1.0
physionet_gait.intended_use: Modality-specific pretraining and feature extraction evaluation for the gait/motor branch
physionet_gait.main_limitation: Single-modality gait force time-series; recorded under controlled laboratory conditions; no non-motor labels

ppmi.name: Parkinson's Progression Markers Initiative
ppmi.label_definition: approx. 1500 (De Novo & Genetic PD) / approx. 600 (RBD, Hyposmia, Genetic Risk) / approx. 800 (Healthy Controls)
ppmi.missingness: Longitudinal attrition, optional sub-study non-completion, visit window missingness
ppmi.access_requirements: Account registration, research plan submission, and signed PPMI Data Use Agreement (DUA)
ppmi.intended_use: Primary dataset for prototype training, multimodal fusion development, and longitudinal validation
ppmi.main_limitation: Complex schema changes across annual data releases; restricted access for specific bio-assays (e.g. SAA)

predict_pd.name: PREDICT-PD Study Cohort
predict_pd.label_definition: Incident PD cases tracked longitudinally / approx. 500 (High-risk prodromal tier) / approx. 8000+ (Low-risk general population controls)
predict_pd.missingness: Self-administered online questionnaire missingness; longitudinal drop-off
predict_pd.access_requirements: Formal collaboration application to study PIs (predictpd@qmul.ac.uk) and institutional ethics committee approval
predict_pd.intended_use: External validation dataset for prodromal risk stratification and non-motor algorithm testing
predict_pd.main_limitation: Not available for open public download; keyboard tapping is less precise than clinical force sensors

retinal_fundus_pretraining.name: Retinal Fundus Pretraining Corpus (EyePACS / Messidor-2 / DRIVE / APTOS)
retinal_fundus_pretraining.missingness: Non-uniform image sizing, illumination gradients, media opacities
retinal_fundus_pretraining.access_requirements: Kaggle user registration and competition terms agreement
retinal_fundus_pretraining.intended_use: Pretraining CNN / Vision Transformer backbones for retinal vessel segmentation and feature representation
retinal_fundus_pretraining.main_limitation: Strictly pretraining only; contains diabetic retinopathy and normal eye images but NO Parkinson's clinical labels

synthetic_fixture.name: MPF-PD Synthetic Test Fixture
synthetic_fixture.label_definition: 35 (Synthetic mock PD class) / 30 (Synthetic mock Prodromal class) / 35 (Synthetic mock Control class)
synthetic_fixture.missingness: Controlled synthetic missingness (10% missing values per column)
synthetic_fixture.intended_use: Unit testing, continuous integration, and pipeline validation
synthetic_fixture.main_limitation: Purely synthetic test fixture; contains zero physiological reality or real patient evidence

uci_voice.name: UCI Parkinson's Telemonitoring Dataset
uci_voice.missingness: Low missingness within acoustic features; uneven recording intervals per patient
uci_voice.intended_use: Modality-specific representation learning and regression target prediction for the speech/voice branch
uci_voice.main_limitation: Small subject count (N=42); lacks healthy control group; single modality (voice only)

notes: All real datasets (PPMI, PREDICT-PD, mPower, UCI Voice, PhysioNet Gait, OCT500) require credentialed access or local download. In accordance with zero fabrication rules, where local raw files are not detected, the system safely uses synthetic fixtures (Category E) explicitly labeled as simulation mode with zero clinical validity.
